#   bands            comma list of VERDICT@#NN@sig:<slug>, or "-". A band MUST name an open

#                    Verdict-enum-only bands are INVALID: a band matching "any ASSERT-FAIL
#                    in this drill" would blind the drill to a NEW red (the c6b9c9e class).
#                    A banded red STILL BLOCKS; it is reported separately, never folded green.
#   owner            open defect ids this row pins (tests/ledger-crosscheck.sh reads this)
#   note-ref         anchor into expected-verdicts-log.md (the drill name)
#   An ARM-SPLIT drill (`# arms:` manifest) has one CHILD row per arm, keyed <drill>.<arm>: the runner
#   judges each arm unit against its own child row. The parent row stays (every drill on disk has one)
#   but is DERIVED — expected = the children's precedence join, nc_gap = their sum, bands `-` — and the
#   children are written from the parent's claim ownership BEFORE the first split sweep, never from it
